import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_N = 10;
    static char[][] map_grid = new char[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] num_scientists = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] num_rescuers = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][] spread_time = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static int[][][][] travel_time = new int[MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N][MAX_N];
    static final int[] dirs = {-1, 0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int TOTAL_VERTICES = 2 * MAX_N * MAX_N + 2;
    static final int LARGE_NUMBER = 1000000000;
    static List<Integer>[] network = new ArrayList[TOTAL_VERTICES + 1];
    static int[][] capacity = new int[TOTAL_VERTICES + 1][TOTAL_VERTICES + 1];
    static int[][] current_flow = new int[TOTAL_VERTICES + 1][TOTAL_VERTICES + 1];
    static int[] dist_level = new int[TOTAL_VERTICES + 1];
    static int[] parent_node = new int[TOTAL_VERTICES + 1];
    static int[] next_edge = new int[TOTAL_VERTICES + 1];

    static boolean constructLevelGraph(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(dist_level, -1);
        dist_level[source] = 0;
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(source);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int u = q.poll();
            for (int v : network[u]) {
                if (capacity[u][v] - current_flow[u][v] > 0 && dist_level[v] == -1) {
                    dist_level[v] = dist_level[u] + 1;
                    q.offer(v);
                }
            }
        }
        return dist_level[sink] != -1;
    }

    static boolean dfsSearch(int u, int sink) {
        if (u == sink) return true;
        for (int i = next_edge[u]; i < network[u].size(); i++) {
            next_edge[u] = i;
            int v = network[u].get(i);
            if (distLevel[v] == distLevel[u] + 1 && capacity[u][v] - current_flow[u][v] > 0 && dfsSearch(v, sink)) {
                parent_node[v] = u;
                return true;
            }
        }
        return false;
    }

    static boolean findAugmentingPath(int source, int sink) {
        Arrays.fill(parent_node, -1);
        parent_node[source] = 0;
        return dfsSearch(source, sink);
    }

    static void initializeFlow() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= TOTAL_VERTICES; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(capacity[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(current_flow[i], 0);
        }
    }

    static void insertEdge(int u, int v, int cap) {
        network[u].add(v);
        network[v].add(u);
        capacity[u][v] += cap;
    }

    static int computeMaxFlow(int source, int sink) {
        int total = 0;
        while (constructLevelGraph(source, sink)) {
            Arrays.fill(next_edge, 0);
            while (findAugmentingPath(source, sink)) {
                int bottleneck = LARGE_NUMBER;
                for (int v = sink, u = parent_node[v]; v != source; v = u, u = parent_node[v]) {
                    bottleneck = Math.min(bottleneck, capacity[u][v] - current_flow[u][v]);
                }
                for (int v = sink, u = parent_node[v]; v != source; v = u, u = parent_node[v]) {
                    current_flow[u][v] += bottleneck;
                    current_flow[v][u] -= bottleneck;
                }
                total += bottleneck;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int getNodeId(int size, int r, int c, boolean isRight) {
        return r * size + c + (isRight ? size * size : 0);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] firstLine = br.readLine().split(" ");
        int n = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[0]);
        int t = Integer.parseInt(firstLine[1]);
        String[] lines = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            lines[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        int[] start = new int[2];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = lines[i].charAt(j);
                if (ch == 'Y') {
                    map_grid[i][j] = 'Y';
                } else if (ch == 'Z') {
                    map_grid[i][j] = 'Z';
                    start[0] = i;
                    start[1] = j;
                } else {
                    map_grid[i][j] = '.';
                    num_scientists[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                char ch = line.charAt(j);
                if (ch != 'Y' && ch != 'Z') {
                    num_rescuers[i][j] += ch - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                Arrays.fill(spread_time[i], -1);
            }
        }
        spread_time[start[0]][start[1]] = 0;
        Queue<int[]> q = new LinkedList<>();
        q.offer(start);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = q.poll();
            int x = cell[0], y = cell[1];
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int nx = x + dirs[k], ny = y + dirs[k + 1];
                if (0 <= nx && nx < n && 0 <= ny && ny < n && map_grid[nx][ny] == '.' && spread_time[nx][ny] == -1) {
                    spread_time[nx][ny] = spread_time[x][y] + 1;
                    q.offer(new int[]{nx, ny});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                for (int ri = 0; ri < n; ri++) {
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < n; rj++) {
                        travel_time[i][j][ri][rj] = -1;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (map_grid[i][j] == '.') {
                    travel_time[i][j][i][j] = 0;
                    Queue<int[]> bfs = new LinkedList<>();
                    bfs.offer(new int[]{i, j});
                    while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
                        int[] cell = bfs.poll();
                        int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
                        if (spread_time[r][c] == -1 || travel_time[i][j][r][c] < spread_time[r][c]) {
                            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                                int nr = r + dirs[k], nc = c + dirs[k + 1];
                                if (0 <= nr && nr < n && 0 <= nc && nc < n && map_grid[nr][nc] == '.' &&
                                    (spread_time[nr][nc] == -1 || travel_time[i][j][r][c] + 1 <= spread_time[nr][nc]) &&
                                    travel_time[i][j][nr][nc] == -1) {
                                    travel_time[i][j][nr][nc] = travel_time[i][j][r][c] + 1;
                                    bfs.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i <= TOTAL_VERTICES; i++) {
            network[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        int source = 2 * n * n;
        int sink = 2 * n * n + 1;
        initializeFlow();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (num_scientists[i][j] > 0) {
                    insertEdge(source, getNodeId(n, i, j, false), num_scientists[i][j]);
                }
                if (num_rescuers[i][j] > 0) {
                    insertEdge(getNodeId(n, i, j, true), sink, num_rescuers[i][j]);
                }
                for (int ri = 0; ri < n; ri++) {
                    for (int rj = 0; rj < n; rj++) {
                        if (travel_time[i][j][ri][rj] != -1 && travel_time[i][j][ri][rj] <= t) {
                            insertEdge(getNodeId(n, i, j, false), getNodeId(n, ri, rj, true), LARGE_NUMBER);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(computeMaxFlow(source, sink));
    }
}
